description: The GoDFIR host lanes (windowlicker, daemonhunter; <lane>/<case>/<tool>/<image>/<artifact>/<tool>.jsonl): event.dataset from the Tool field, else the tool directory (so every goese table is dataset goese with the table in goese.table), labels.case/labels.item from the path; evidence time from the first of the tool's own time fields that is set — the envelope's EventTime, TimeStamp/Timestamp, SourceModified (gole, goprefetch), then goevtx TimeCreated, gomft Created0x10 (the $STANDARD_INFORMATION creation time; the MFT's other seven timestamps stay as fields), goamcache FileKeyLastWriteTimestamp, goappcompat LastModifiedTimeUTC, gowxt StartTime/LastModifiedTime, gorb DeletedOn, gosbe LastWriteTime and gore LastWriteTimestamp (both `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSS`, UTC); an epoch-zero value is a sentinel, not a time. host.name from the envelope's Host.Hostname, else goevtx's Computer, else the image the artifact came from. gojle's AppId object moves to jumplist.app so the SRUM tables' integer AppId keeps its mapping; goevtx's Payload (a JSON string) is parsed into winlog.event_data; ECS copies for goevtx (event.code, winlog.*, user.id), gomft (file.*) and the daemonhunter Message.

grok.description: <lane>/<case>/<tool>/<image>/...: the case, the tool and the image the artifact came from
a record outside the <case>/<tool>/<image> layout: the output filename names the dataset

set.description: goese: one file per ESE table; the table's alias (ApplicationResourceUsage, ...) or raw name

set.if: ctx.event?.dataset == 'goese' && ctx.goese?.table == null && ctx.Table instanceof String

rename.description: gojle writes AppId as {AppId, Description}; the SRUM tables write it as an integer — one name cannot be both

script.description: the evidence time: the first set field of the tool's own time columns, in this order; an epoch-zero string is a sentinel
script.source: def order = ['EventTime', 'TimeStamp', 'Timestamp', 'SourceModified', 'TimeCreated', 'Created0x10', 'FileKeyLastWriteTimestamp', 'LastModifiedTimeUTC', 'StartTime', 'LastModifiedTime', 'DeletedOn', 'LastWriteTime', 'LastWriteTimestamp']; for (String f : order) { def v = ctx[f]; if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && !v.startsWith('1970-01-01T00:00:00') && !v.startsWith('0001-01-01')) { ctx._tmp_time = v; break; } }

set.if: ctx.Host instanceof Map && ctx.Host.Hostname instanceof String

set.description: no hostname in the record: the image the artifact came from stands in

json.description: goevtx writes the EventData as a JSON string; the parsed tree lands flattened (searchable, no mapper cost)

script.if: ctx.event?.dataset == 'gomft' && ctx.ParentPath instanceof String && ctx.FileName instanceof String && ctx.file?.path == null
script.source: String d = ctx.ParentPath; if (!(ctx.file instanceof Map)) { ctx.file = [:]; } ctx.file.path = (d.endsWith('/') ? d : d + '/') + ctx.FileName;

set.description: the daemonhunter parsers' Message (syslog/journal line) is the record's message
